notes: Clauses about life span, death, named diseases and physical defects are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy; affected rules list them in 'dropped'.

skipped.reason: Death of children, sterility and childlessness timing: excluded by policy.
Parentage and birth-circumstance verses: not suitable for a report.
Exact number of children: depends on exaltation degrees and mixes in deaths; not encoded.

variants.text: The ascendant lord and 5th lord in the 5th, an angle or a trine: full happiness through children.
The 5th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th: children are delayed or denied.
The 5th lord is combust, weak and with a malefic: serious obstacles to having children.

rules.text: The 9th lord in the 5th, a debilitated 5th lord, and Mercury with Ketu in the 5th: a child comes only after great effort.
A debilitated 5th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th, or in an enemy's sign, with malefics in the 5th: a child comes only after great effort.
Six planets in the 5th with its lord in the 12th: a child through adoption is indicated.
Mercury, Jupiter and Venus aspect the 5th house and its lord is strong: many children.
The 5th lord with the Moon: the text says daughters are more likely.
rules.note: The verse also requires the 5th lord to be in the Moon's decanate; encoded without that condition.

rules.text: An exalted 5th lord in the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 5th or 9th, joined or aspected by Jupiter: the blessing of a son.
Three or more malefics in the 5th with no benefic influence and a debilitated 5th lord: a pull towards low-grade or unworthy work.

variants.text: Jupiter in the 5th and the 5th lord with Venus: the text times a child around the 32nd–33rd year.
The 5th lord in an angle with Jupiter: the text times a child around the 30th or 36th year.
Jupiter in the 9th with Venus 9th from it, or the ascendant lord with Venus: the text times a child around the 40th year.
